details: The Liquid Network, a Bitcoin sidechain, reportedly experienced a drain of $320 million in Bitcoin by individuals identified as "white-hat" hackers. These hackers have indicated their intention to return the funds after addressing the underlying vulnerabilities.
title: Liquid Network Suffers $320M Bitcoin Drain by 'White-Hat' Hackers

details: Bitcoin faced a rejection at the $80,500 price level and is currently consolidating near $79,000. Investors are closely watching upcoming U.S. inflation data and central bank policy announcements, which are influencing market sentiment.
title: Bitcoin Price Rejects $80.5K Amidst Market Consolidation

details: Ethereum is advancing plans for a significant upgrade in 2027 that will enable users to pay for network gas fees without needing to hold Ether (ETH). This development aims to enhance user experience and broaden accessibility to the network.
title: Ethereum Plans 2027 Upgrade to Allow Gas Payments Without ETH

details: Harmony, once considered a promising rival to Ethereum, has proposed to shut down its layer 1 blockchain and migrate its ONE token to the Ethereum network. The decision stems from security concerns, specifically citing threats related to artificial intelligence.
title: Harmony Blockchain Proposes Shutdown Over AI-Related Security Threats

details: Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) are maintaining significant institutional interest, with weekly inflows consistently approaching the $1 billion mark. This trend underscores a continued recovery in institutional demand for Bitcoin investment products.
title: Bitcoin ETFs Continue Strong Inflows, Nearing $1 Billion Weekly
